title: For a vessel heated to a programmed curve, should temperature be measured in the furnace or inside the vessel?
summary: Two Suneng proposals for the same project cover external heating of an impregnation vessel and internal heating of a baking vessel respectively. For equipment following programmed heating and cooling curves, procurement should confirm more than maximum temperature: where the curve is controlled, what load is used for testing and which curve version forms the agreed reference all matter.
